rule dac_gh_0021 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Org MFA requirement disabled or relaxed - org.disable_two_factor_requirement"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0021"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1556.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.disable_two_factor_requirement" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "business.disable_two_factor_requirement" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
